rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an inflatable balloon.

example.traditional: 呢個氣球好快就漏氣喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hei3 kau4 hou2 faai3 zau6 lau6 hei3 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a hot-air balloon that carries people or equipment.

example.english: We took a hot-air balloon to watch the sunrise.
example.traditional: 我哋搭熱氣球去睇日出。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 jit6 hei3 kau4 heoi3 tai2 jat6 ceot1
